list_participant_groups: list all participant groups from the prolific API filtered by project id or active status
retrieve_participant_group: retrieve a single participant group by its id from the prolific API
create_participant_group: create a new participant group on prolific with the provided data fields
remove_participant_group: remove a participant group by its id from the prolific API
add_participants_to_group: add participants to a prolific participant group by their participant ids
